column1: **NhydroAuxScalars:** Number of prognostic auxiliary scalar fields
**AuxScAdvSelector:** Advection scheme for auxiliary scalar fields *C-M if NhydroAuxScalars > 0*
**AuxScAdvSelector_b_hyb:** Hybrid advection scheme parameter *C-M if NhydroAuxScalars > 0*
**AuxScSGSturb:** Selector to apply sub-grid scale diffusion to auxiliary scalar fields *C-M if NhydroAuxScalars > 0*
**srcAuxScFile:** The path and filename to an Auxilliary Scalar Sources specification file *C-O if NhydroAuxScalars > 0*
**srcAuxScTemporalType:** Temporal characterization of source (0=instantaneous; 1=continuous) *C-M if srcAuxScFile == NULL and NhydroAuxScalars == 1*
**srcAuxScStartSeconds:** Source start time in seconds *C-M if srcAuxScFile == NULL and NhydroAuxScalars == 1*
**srcAuxScDurationSeconds:** Source duration in seconds *C-M if srcAuxScFile == NULL and NhydroAuxScalars == 1*
**srcAuxScGeometryType:** 0=point (single cell volume); 1=line (line of surface cells) *C-M if srcAuxScFile == NULL and NhydroAuxScalars == 1*
**srcAuxScMassSpecType:** Mass specification type 0=strict mass in kg; 1=mass source rate in kg/s *C-M if srcAuxScFile == NULL and NhydroAuxScalars == 1*
**srcAuxScMassSpecValue:** Mass specification value in kg or kg/s given by srcAuxScMassSpecType 0 or 1 *C-M if srcAuxScFile == NULL and NhydroAuxScalars == 1*
**srcAuxScLocation_X:** Source geometry centroid position in x (west-east) *C-M if srcAuxScFile == NULL and NhydroAuxScalars == 1*
**srcAuxScLocation_Y:** Source geometry centroid position in y (south-north) *C-M if srcAuxScFile == NULL and NhydroAuxScalars == 1*
**srcAuxScLocation_Z:** Source geometry centroid position in z (vertical above the surface) *C-M if srcAuxScFile == NULL and NhydroAuxScalars == 1*
